zh.title: 阿聯酋航空取得杜拜—柏林每週七班航權，擬用777-300ER
zh.summary: 阿聯酋取得杜拜—柏林每週七班航權，擬用777-300ER；777X預期2027年第二季交機。
body: Simple Flying於10月25日報導，德國已於2026年9月批准阿聯酋航空開闢杜拜國際機場（DXB）至柏林布蘭登堡機場（BER）的每日航班。柏林將成為阿聯酋航空第五個德國客運航點。
航權允許每週最多七班，未包含第五航權，因此阿聯酋航空可經營杜拜與柏林間的直飛航班，但不能憑這項航權在柏林與第三國之間載客。
報導引述AeroTime指出，阿聯酋航空計畫先以波音777-300ER執飛規劃中的德國航線，待777-9準備就緒。柏林航線的初期機型規劃因此使用現有777-300ER，並非等待777X交機後才安排。
至於後續機隊更新，阿聯酋航空共有270架波音777X訂單，原報導列出的預期交機時程為2027年第二季。

en.title: Emirates Wins Seven Weekly Dubai-Berlin Flights, Plans Initial 777-300ER Service
en.summary: Emirates secures seven weekly Dubai-Berlin flights, plans 777-300ER service; 777X deliveries are expected in Q2 2027.
body: Simple Flying reported on October 25 that Germany approved daily Emirates services between Dubai International Airport (DXB) and Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) in September 2026. Berlin would become the airline's fifth German passenger destination.

The approval limits Emirates to seven weekly flights and does not grant fifth-freedom rights. It covers direct services between Dubai and Berlin rather than permission to carry passengers between Berlin and a third country.

Citing AeroTime, the report says Emirates plans to use Boeing 777-300ER aircraft for its proposed German services until the 777-9 is ready. The initial Berlin aircraft plan relies on the existing 777-300ER fleet rather than waiting for 777X deliveries.
For its longer-term fleet renewal, Emirates has 270 Boeing 777X aircraft on order, with deliveries expected in the second quarter of 2027 according to the report.
